classification.sub: Through **hh:hvsoc:Power:Tajik-Sign(**) it is clear that Afghan Sign Language is not related to Tajik Sign Language and that influence and/or origins are likely to lie with (Indo-)Pakistan Sign Language or ASL. There is some ASL lexical influence (**hh:phon:Power:Afghan-Sign**, **hh:h:Morgan:Southern-Asia**) but a systematic comparison remains to be done with ASL, (Indo-)Pakistani Sign or any other sign language. Hence, it is a presumed isolate.
